identity.name: CharlestonHacks
identity.summary: CharlestonHacks is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit growing South Carolina's technology community through free events, open collaboration, and inclusive membership.
identity.mission: Grow Charleston's technology community through high-quality events, open collaboration, and inclusive membership. Membership is always free.
values: Independent: community-led, so decisions serve members first
Connectors: bringing builders together across disciplines
Experimental: testing ideas in public and learning quickly

offers.label: HarborHack annual hackathon
offers.description: Free, in-person, team-based hackathon held every October in Charleston since 2023, open to students, developers, designers and founders of all skill levels, with mentors and expert judges.

evidence.description: HarborHack 2026: Agent in the Loop (event archive)

offers.label: Other hackathons
offers.description: Additional free hackathons, including a month-long online hackathon and multi-night build events.

evidence.description: CharlestonHacks Innovation Engine online hackathon, June 2025

offers.label: Show & Tell
offers.description: Monthly evening where community members demo what they are building, held at rotating Charleston venues.

evidence.description: Show & Tell at Freehouse Brewery, November 2026

offers.label: Tech Happy Hours and community meetups
offers.description: Recurring free social meetups for Charleston's tech and creative community, including joint events with other local groups.

evidence.description: Archive of CharlestonHacks public events since October 2023

offers.label: Creative technology events
offers.description: Events at the intersection of technology and the arts, such as an AI film festival and a hacker theater night.

offers.label: Charleston Tech Week events
offers.description: Community events during Charleston Tech Week, such as the 30 Second AI Film Fest.
